name: @caisson-sh/lint-policy
description: The shared lint-policy data + the custom lint plugin. Holds boundary-policy.cjs (the ONE provider-SDK / bundle-meta data source read by oxlint, dependency-cruiser and the standards gate) and the caisson-slop plugin oxlint loads via jsPlugins. Rule severities live in the root .oxlintrc.json (ADR-0408); this package is data and plugins, not config.

scripts.lint: echo 'lint-policy: policy + plugin package, linted by the root oxlint run'
